digest.component_or_area: bridge command surface and tracker sync
propositions: A unified provider-neutral bridge command surface replaces fragmented tracker-specific operator workflows while retaining legacy contract compatibility
Canonical verbs setup, check-access, fsck, status, preview, sync, pause, and resume are exposed through rebar bridge CLI, Python library, and MCP server with shared core implementation
Argument-less reconcile remains non-mutating dry-run while argument-less bridge sync is the canonical mutating command; legacy exit codes 3/4/75 translate through explicit adapters to canonical 0/1/2
Durable remote-persisted pause state with reason is readable by mixed-version fleets; destructive repair and normal operation no longer require GitHub gh CLI dependency
Core tickets-branch CAS delivery ownership moved to Python src/rebar/_store/push.py with strict failure classification and terminal push budget; workflow-local retry loops removed

Bridge implementation is runner-neutral across local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments using shared Python core; no new shell runner or editable checkout dependency introduced
